data_source_policy: v3 replaces weak PDB resolution/assembly-count proxy with actual stability-dataset gate. PDB metadata alone is not evidence.

falsification_logic.caveat: If only PDB metadata is available, the result is data_limited rather than suggestive.
falsification_logic.confirm_like: Public stability/Tm/ΔG datasets show a positive stability residual for symmetry/order proxies after length/organism/method controls.
falsification_logic.falsify_like: Adequate stability datasets show no advantage or an opposite trend.
